nodes.label: Phase 1 Slice 1 — Local Ingest to a Visible Grid
nodes.rationale: Twelve tasks turning a mesh file in a mounted directory into a card with a real rendered thumbnail. A read-only mounted directory is walked by a scan endpoint that mounts only in the worker role; new files are parsed, rasterized, written to a content-addressed blob store and recorded in one transaction.

nodes.label: Hash-First Short-Circuit
nodes.rationale: BLAKE3 before anything else in ingest. A known hash short-circuits the whole pipeline, which is what makes re-dropping the same folder complete in seconds instead of re-parsing and re-rendering every file.

nodes.label: Role-Aware Router
nodes.rationale: router(state) becomes router(state, role), breaking both existing call sites on purpose: a route can no longer mount without declaring which role serves it. lapidary-server reads LAPIDARY_ROLE and selects the router; the scan endpoint mounts only under Role::Worker.

nodes.label: Blob CAS
nodes.rationale: Content-addressed blob store split into SourceStore and DerivativeStore so the open-path boundary is expressible in the type system — lapidary-api may not so much as name SourceStore. Content addressing is not authorization: knowing a blob hash never grants access.

nodes.label: MeshKernel
nodes.rationale: Wires parse_stl, measure and render_thumbnail behind the existing Kernel trait, and is the first consumer of RASTER_VERSION — which must be embedded in KernelVersion because derivative.kernel_version is the only thing distinguishing a regenerated thumbnail from a stale one.

nodes.label: CPU Thumbnail Rasterizer
nodes.rationale: Mesh to 512px WebP bytes, CPU only, with a downscale-and-retry fallback under a byte budget. image 0.25.10 encodes WebP with no C dependency and its whole tree is inside deny.toml's allow-list — checked before it was written into the plan, not after.

nodes.label: MeshMeasurements
nodes.rationale: With Provenance, the vocabulary both the kernel and the DB speak. Measurement must not lie: mesh-derived values are labelled approximate, and where the honest answer is no answer, write NULL rather than a plausible number.

nodes.label: Keyset-Paginated Grid Endpoint
nodes.rationale: GET /api/libraries/{id}/parts returns thumbnails inline as bytea so a page costs one query. sqlx 0.9 has no jiff feature, so the grid query selects microseconds and rebuilds through jiff::Timestamp::from_microsecond — caught by verifying rather than assuming, before the plan was written.

nodes.label: The Verification Bar
nodes.rationale: Exactly what ci.yml runs, and a task is not done until it passes: fmt, clippy -D warnings, check-layers, check-deploy, the test suite against a live PostgreSQL 18, and cargo deny. It grows over slices as gaps are found — check-strings, export-bindings, export-agents-md, check-commit-msg, and finally the web suite. Never pipe these through tail or grep when the exit code matters; a pipeline reports its last command's status.
